title: a command and a specification in different domains
when: Loads a command that checks a specification of another domain.
then: Expects a `link-scope` refusal on `checks.jsonl` saying `checks` links records of one domain.

title: A space's index holds only its product's records, links, parts, coverage and problems, and the records and problems of no product
when: Builds the Demo shop and Notebook space indexes from a workspace where Demo shop's use case follows and names Notebook's `NF-NOTE`, with a use case of no product and a problem on the crossing link.
then: Expects each space's index to hold its own records, parts and those of no product, no link into the other, its own coverage, and its problems with the workspace's.

title: A list splits by kind only when it holds more than one kind, whatever the focus, depth or filters
when: Reads the graph's tree under an aggregate with four kinds of child and a use case with seven UC requirements, frames the aggregate at depth 3 with commands hidden, then opens an endpoint's and a command's pages.
then: Expects an aggregate's children of four kinds in a group each, a use case's seven requirements straight under it, the tree the same after a filtered, deeper neighborhood, and the record page titling a list of one kind by the kind and a mixed one Children.

title: Filters hide kinds and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides use cases, entities, aggregates and the focus's own kind.
then: Expects the hidden records to go, nothing to be reached through them, a folder gone with its kind while a stage stays, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: A folder opens only when it holds lathe.config.json or a data folder
when: With Lathe's own config module: builds folders with a `lathe.config.json` that names a data folder or none, with only `data/`, with neither, with a broken config, one with a setting Lathe does not know, a plain file and a missing path, and a folder whose `data/product.jsonl` names two products; and loads the module from this repo's source.
then: Expects a configured folder to open on its named data folder or `data`, a plain `data/` folder to open, an empty one refused as having `no lathe.config.json and no data folder`, a broken config refused as `not valid JSON`, an unknown setting refused with Lathe's reason, a file or a missing path refused; the window titled `Lathe, Tool Library — ~/Development/Lathe` from the products, or `product — /srv/product` with none; and the module's path in the repo and in the packed app.

title: In development the window uses the 5199 server only when it answers for the opened folder
when: Chooses the development source against a fake 5199 that answers for the folder, for another folder, without the header, with an error, or not at all.
then: Expects the shared `http://localhost:5199` when it answers 200 for the opened folder, or names no folder and the folder is the repo; and a server of its own when it names another folder, answers 500, does not answer, or names no folder and the folder is another product.

title: A domain follows a pattern itself or through any of its use cases
when: A domain follows one pattern through its use case and another itself.
then: Expects both rules counted there, each once.

title: Each domain that follows a pattern owes its rules, on one pattern rule line
when: Adds a second domain, Shop, whose use case follows the complete product's pattern and gives its setting, with no pattern rule test of its own.
then: Expects EX-LEND's `pattern_rule` line proof-only and covered for its one rule; EX-SHOP's to owe that rule designed and built but not proved; and the gap `Pattern rule EX-PAT-ACT-R01 is not proved yet in EX-SHOP.`
